request.query: pigeonhole principle map from a larger finite set to a smaller finite set

items.name: Finset.exists_le_card_fiber_of_mul_le_card_of_maps_to
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} {f : α → β} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) → t.Nonempty → t.card * n ≤ s.card → ∃ y ∈ t, n ≤ {x ∈ s | f x = y}.card

items.name: Set.exists_ne_map_eq_of_ncard_lt_of_maps_to
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Set α} {t : Set β},
  t.ncard < s.ncard →
    ∀ {f : α → β},
      (∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) →
        autoParam t.Finite Set.exists_ne_map_eq_of_ncard_lt_of_maps_to._auto_1 → ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y

items.name: Finset.exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card_of_maps_to
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} {f : α → β} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) → t.card * n < s.card → ∃ y ∈ t, n < {x ∈ s | f x = y}.card

items.name: Fintype.exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq β] [inst_1 : Fintype α] [inst_2 : Fintype β] (f : α → β) {n : ℕ},
  Fintype.card β * n < Fintype.card α → ∃ y, n < {x | f x = y}.card

items.name: Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] (f : α → β),
  Fintype.card β < Fintype.card α → ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y

items.name: Fintype.exists_card_fiber_le_of_card_le_mul
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq β] [inst_1 : Fintype α] [inst_2 : Fintype β] (f : α → β) {n : ℕ}
  [Nonempty β], Fintype.card α ≤ Fintype.card β * n → ∃ y, {x | f x = y}.card ≤ n
